sources.title: Amazon S3 pricing
sources.claim_used: S3 charges requests by request type and currently provides the first 100 GB per month of internet data transfer out free, aggregated across AWS services and regions except China and GovCloud.

sources.title: Using Requester Pays general purpose buckets for storage transfers and usage
sources.claim_used: Requester Pays shifts request and data-download charges from the bucket owner to the requester.

billing_notes: The workflow will run from GitHub-hosted infrastructure, so S3-to-internet data transfer rules may apply if the account has already exhausted applicable free outbound transfer.
This evidence does not assert the account's remaining free transfer allowance, taxes, FX conversion or final invoice amount.
The approved request count and byte caps are the enforceable cost-control boundary; pricing evidence cannot expand them.
No additional request is authorized for pricing discovery or post-run billing inspection.
